schema_version.description: This field identifies the data contract version, not a claim of implementation readiness.

id.description: This value uniquely identifies the record within its declared entity and version scope.

case_version_id.description: This identifier refers to one immutable case version.

type.description: This field selects the typed evidence or source-reference class.

subject_ids.description: These IDs identify the exact units or entities supported by this evidence.

parent_evidence_ids.description: These IDs link the evidence to the actual earlier records that it depends on.

asset_sha256.description: This hash identifies the actual stored asset bytes.

raw_private_asset_id.description: This identifier locates restricted original evidence on the server.

provider_profile_id.description: This identifier selects one versioned provider configuration.

method_version.description: This field identifies the exact method used for the evidence.

observed.description: This field records evidence produced by the named method.

numeric_measure.description: This field contains an actual measurement with its method and unit.

unit.description: This field identifies the measurement unit declared by the parent object.

source_id.description: This identifier refers to a source in the source registry.

locator.description: This field locates the cited evidence within the named source.

evidence_hash.description: This hash identifies the exact evidence payload.

source_refs.description: These references locate actual supporting material in named sources.

epistemic_status.description: This field separates requests, inference, measurement, and human observation.

created_at.description: This field records the actual creation time with its timezone.

subject_audio_sha256.description: The final delivery audio digest for acoustic evidence. This is not the digest of a raw provider response.
